title: Owens' 168 demonstrations over 20 years
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Owens' 168 demonstrations over 20 years, about 1960s-1987 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 168 different demonstrations he performed over a period of 20 years. Roughly twothirds of them worked out the way he said they would.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic phenomena, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a man named Ted Owens, who said in advance that certain events would happen as demonstrations of his powers. Drawing on his own files on Owens, Mishlove says Owens did 168 such demonstrations over about 20 years, from the 1960s to 1987, and roughly two thirds turned out the way he said they would. If true, it would be a striking record of psychic ability.
